Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1
stated that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side while turning left by a vehicle proceeding through the
intersection. Driver 2 confirmed this account and did not dispute the sequnece of events. Two independent witnesses
at the scene described the collision in the same manner, and photographs taken at the location show the points of
contact consistent with a side impact of this type. The damage observed on Driver 1's vehicle, including deformation
to the driver's door and quarter panel, corresponds closely with the impact described. Driver 1 reported a concussion
and was transported for evaluation; the nature of the injury is consistent with the force of the collision. Passenger was
also present in the vehicle, and officers and wintesses confirmed that Passenger was seated in the front passenger
position at the time of impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to the vehicle in the areas affected. Driver
1 is listed as a named driver on the applicable policy.
